purpose: Source-linked review of existing reference rules and safety disposition. Software decisions and synthetic tests are not clinical validation.
scope: No new symptom options, condition IDs, anatomy models, treatment prescriptions or remote medical inference.

entries.type: Conservative application output policy

sources.title: SANJO guideline: diagnostic approach, recommendations 1 and 3
sources.use: A clinical presentation alone cannot confirm or exclude joint infection; suspected infection requires timely assessment.

sources.title: MSD Professional: Splenic Injury
sources.use: Trauma assessment requires attention to potentially serious causes; a superficial reference match cannot establish stability.

sources.title: NHS: chest pain
sources.use: The action for high-risk chest symptoms must not be reduced by a benign-looking reference match.

sources.title: NHS: blood in urine
sources.use: Blood in urine warrants prompt assessment; associated fever changes the immediate evaluation context without proving obstruction.

sources.title: NHS: ectopic pregnancy symptoms
sources.use: Actual pain, shoulder-tip pain or fainting with possible pregnancy changes urgency. Pregnancy possibility alone does not establish pain.

sources.title: MSD Professional: Jaundice
sources.use: Fever and abdominal symptoms are important associated findings; laboratory tests and imaging are needed to distinguish causes.

entries.decision: Separate immediate, same-day and prompt assessment guidance from rule-match scores. When a priority warning is triggered, retained reference cards use the most urgent actual guidance instead of their routine self-care instructions. Priority cards do not display a numerical rank.
entries.appliesTo: Only inputs that already trigger an explicit priority rule. The ordinary no-warning path is unchanged. Coexisting warnings remain visible and are ordered by disposition.
notEstablished: The sources do not validate this application's scores or diagnostic accuracy.
A missing checkbox is unknown, not a negative examination.
A prompt or same-day recommendation is not silently promoted to an emergency recommendation.

positiveExamples.expected: Immediate assessment remains the action on every retained card, including an abdominal-wall reference match.
The bowel-reference score cannot override the same-day assessment instruction.
Immediate guidance precedes prompt guidance; neither warning is discarded.

negativeExamples.expected: No new priority warning; the existing ordinary reference advice is retained.
Prompt assessment remains prompt, not an automatic emergency disposition.
Timing and location alone do not establish abdominal pain.
A risk-context checkbox alone does not invent pain or a condition card.

entries.type: Professional-source review with conservative software mapping
entries.decision: Swelling/redness and local heat or purulent drainage around an existing joint region receive same-day assessment even if fever is unreported. This does not confirm joint infection or gout.

Patella.r: 局部肿胀 + 局部压痛 + 流脓, without reported heat or fever
negativeExamples: Patella.r: 局部肿胀 only; 发热 only
notEstablished: No clinical diagnostic validation, no inferred negative examination, and no new options or condition IDs.

sources.title: AHA/ACC Chest Pain Guideline: pressure/tightness terminology

entries.decision: The existing exertional chest-pressure label counts as chest discomfort for triage. Related radiation labels are recognized as reported pain where their displayed text explicitly says pain, without adding an independent evidence family or diagnosing a cardiac condition. A final audit checked every visible bilingual label rather than IDs alone: the delayed-exercise label already reports soreness; meal-related abdominal pain and twisting/stretching pain already report pain. These observations can satisfy existing triage pain semantics without another generic-pain checkbox, but their evidence families and condition gates are not expanded. Shoulder-tip, flank and groin-radiating pain are still not relabeled upper-abdominal pain.
positiveExamples: Heart: 运动诱发胸闷 + 冷汗
Sternum: 运动诱发胸闷 + 气短
Sternum: 局部压痛 + 活动诱发 + 气短
Rectus femoris: 新运动后1至3天 + 尿色深 + 肌力下降
Actual RUQ: 油腻餐后痛 or 进食后腹痛 + 发热
Sternum: 新运动后1至3天 + 气短
negativeExamples: Heart: 运动诱发胸闷 alone does not produce a cardiac diagnosis card
Timing alone does not establish pain
Sternum: 局部压痛 + 活动诱发 remains non-emergency
Shoulder-tip or flank pain is not relabeled as local upper abdominal pain solely from a model location
Delayed exercise soreness without the dark-urine/strength-or-progression combination is not automatically an emergency.
notEstablished: Neither cardiac disease nor a specific organ lesion is confirmed.

entries.type: Faithful input description and conservative reference display

sources.title: ICHD-3: migraine without aura diagnostic criteria, pages 18–19

entries.decision: Descriptions separate possible patterns from uncollected starting point, actual pain location, laterality, aura, bone tenderness or increased load. Explicit seconds-to-minutes episodes with migraine-like features are shown as a broad headache direction, not a typical migraine reference; the existing English duration label now matches Chinese. Canonical input ordering stabilizes evidence rendering. The same explicit seconds-to-minutes conflict also withholds the typical tension-type reference, preserving a broad direction and all danger actions. The existing urine option English now matches its Chinese wording (unable to pass urine); neither the ID nor its rule is expanded. Actual visible wording is authoritative: the first-step option already reports heel pain, so that location is retained; the particular heel tissue remains unconfirmed.
positiveExamples: Frontal bone: 跳痛 + 畏光 + 短暂发作 returns broad headache direction
Equivalent reordered canonical reports return identical output.
Frontal bone: 紧箍感 + 双侧头痛 + 短暂发作 returns a broad direction, without clinical exclusion.
negativeExamples: Frontal bone: 跳痛 + 畏光 without reported brief episodes retains a qualified migraine-like reference.
notEstablished: This is a conservative display constraint, not medical exclusion of migraine: age, treatment, episode count and full course are missing. No diagnosis is established by a reference match.

sources.use: Terms 02.1542–1547 distinguish interspinales and intertransversarii; 02.1108/02.1110 distinguish the two ligament families. PDF pages 118 and 93.

sources.title: IFAA/FIPAT TA98: muscles of back
sources.use: A04.3.01.014–016 distinguish lateral lumbar intertransversarii dorsal and ventral parts.

entries.decision: Correct the ventral lateral lumbar intertransversarii Chinese name, normalize its dorsal counterpart, and correct intertransverse ligaments. A narrow spine alias retains the existing region after removing the erroneous spinous word.
positiveExamples: Ventral/dorsal parts on both sides use 腰横突间外侧肌 + subdivision.
Intertransverse ligaments use 横突间韧带 on both sides.
negativeExamples: Interspinales remain 棘间肌; interspinous ligaments remain 棘间韧带.
Original English labels, mesh names, side suffixes and clinical regions remain unchanged.
notEstablished: This verifies naming and identity mapping, not geometric laterality or patient pathology.

entries.type: Input-faithful reference copy and single-observation broad assessment

sources.title: Existing bilingual observations and reference content at reviewed project baseline
sources.use: Software source for the actual reported label meanings; this is not independent clinical evidence.

entries.decision: Descriptions present associated cramps, groin radiation, heat, bruising and swelling as possible reference features, not additional patient observations. The existing delayed-exercise timing label explicitly reports soreness, so it supports a single broad basic card; it still counts as one exercise evidence family and cannot alone create a specific condition card.
positiveExamples: Diarrhoea + fever does not report cramps.
Colic + haematuria does not report groin radiation.
Redness + movement restriction does not report local heat.
Pain + injury does not report bruising.
The sole 新运动后1至3天 label already contains soreness in both visible languages.
negativeExamples: Pure durations or worsening without a reported symptom still do not fabricate pain.
Reference gates, why observations and triage are not broadened by the copy changes.
notEstablished: No new clinical association or diagnostic criterion is introduced; this is fidelity to existing inputs and general reference wording.

entries.type: Existing observation semantics, region filtering and conservative source clarification

sources.title: AAE: Tooth pain, sharp pain when biting
sources.use: Biting pain can have several dental causes and warrants dental examination; it does not establish one diagnosis.

sources.title: NIDCR: Temporomandibular disorders
sources.use: Chewing/jaw symptoms can involve the face or neck and require examination; retain head/neck referral contexts.

sources.title: NHS: Temporomandibular disorder
sources.use: Jaw, ear and temple symptoms can be related to chewing.

sources.title: NHS: Toothache
sources.use: Dental review is advised for tooth pain with fever or pain on biting; this page does not establish a mandatory same-day two-checkbox rule.

sources.title: NHS: Dental abscess
sources.use: Suspected abscess needs urgent dental care; current inputs do not prove an abscess.

entries.decision: The existing pain-on-biting observation stays in the pain evidence family but is removed from generic local-pain gates. Existing explicit dental/jaw rules remain. Its visible entries are teeth, jaw, ear, head and neck, including the organ-filter boundary. Old wrong-area inputs remain in the report and receive source-clarification wording rather than being silently erased or converted to limb/abdominal pain. Other independent symptoms and actions remain in force.
positiveExamples: Tooth: 咬合痛 + 牙龋洞 / 外伤后 / 牙龈肿胀 retains the corresponding existing gated reference.
Jaw: 咬合痛 + 张口弹响 retains the existing jaw reference.
Humerus: 咬合痛 + 疼痛 + 外伤后 still has actual local pain and injury evidence; biting does not appear as local evidence.
Ear/head/neck and legacy wrong-area biting with fever/chills receive source-neutral same-day dental/medical assessment.
negativeExamples: 咬合痛 + 疼痛 are not two independent pain observations.
Biting plus injury or posture does not establish arm, knee, abdominal, splenic or local neck pain.
Biting alone is not automatically urgent or a diagnosis.
A separate back-radiation pain label, breathing difficulty or sudden neurological/hearing change keeps its existing action.
notEstablished: Same-day timing for reported biting pain with fever/chills is a conservative application disposition extending the existing dental tier while the source is unconfirmed, not a guideline-validated score or proof of infection.
Anatomy selection cannot confirm the source or side of referred pain. No global symptom or condition ID is added.

entries.type: Conservative dental contact timing for existing reported observations

sources.title: SDCEP: Acute periodontal conditions
sources.use: Pain and gingival swelling can occur in acute periodontal problems. Urgent dental care is distinct from medical emergency care for airway compromise.

sources.title: SDCEP: Timescales for treatment
sources.use: Urgent dental care is the next available clinic, within 24 hours or as soon as practicable, with clinical judgement and local service constraints.

entries.decision: In existing tooth/jaw entries, reported gum swelling with 疼痛, 咬合痛, 持续冷热痛, 自发痛 or 夜间痛 prompts contact with a dentist today for triage and examination. This is a conservative application mapping for unassessed painful swelling, independent of candidate condition names. Injury is neither required nor proof of infection. Existing emergency airway/opening actions remain higher priority.
positiveExamples: Lower canine.l and Mandible: each of the five explicit pain labels plus 牙龈肿胀; no redundant generic pain is needed.
Superficial part of masseter.r consumes the same existing jaw observations; the test checks both deployed detail levels for the actual mesh.
Adding 外伤后 preserves the action without establishing a cause.
The action remains after dental-abscess and dental-fracture reference cards are removed from a test knowledge copy.
negativeExamples: Biting pain alone, injury with biting pain, isolated swelling, or bleeding with swelling does not acquire this new action.
Brief thermal sensitivity, 紧绷 and remote/radiating pain do not satisfy this sufficient trigger.
Restricted opening, swallowing or breathing still retains the existing emergency tier.
notEstablished: These observations do not diagnose an abscess, spreading infection, periodontal disease or acute onset.
The five-label trigger is not an exclusion test: other symptoms can still need dental care.
No validated two-checkbox score, diagnostic performance or guaranteed local access within 24 hours is claimed. No new symptom, condition or anatomy model is added.

retainedBoundaries.reason: Age, full episode frequency/duration, treatment response, objective neurological/joint/eye/hearing examination, laboratories and imaging are not collected. Do not claim complete ICHD, Ottawa imaging, stone obstruction or organ diagnosis.
Unticked symptoms are unknown. Cannot infer no fever/infection, no pregnancy, no neurological finding, stable bleeding, confirmed side or absence of serious disease.

No hearing subtype, monocular/binocular diplopia, eye versus periocular pus origin, bleed volume, continuous active bleeding or completed pressure trial is known. Preserve explicit conditional safety-net instructions.
Checkbox weakness is not an examination. The actual weight-loss label reports unintentional loss, but does not establish a cause. Model anatomy cannot prove the symptomatic tissue or source.

Do not add hard diagnostic gates from inaccessible complete sources, historical disease mechanisms, conflicting rest/activity advice, or superficial resemblance. No new medication, imaging decision or diagnosis model was introduced.

Pin-prick and stinging words are not established as interchangeable in every condition. They share a general pain evidence family, but no unsupported blanket synonym substitution was added. Exact duplication and ordering are stable.
The existing autonomic-assessment condition has no selectable structure in the current three layers. It remains explicitly unavailable; no model was added to make a test pass.
Public-source review and synthetic software tests cannot estimate diagnostic accuracy, sensitivity, specificity or patient safety. No patient dataset or clinician validation is claimed.
